Flow.description: Customized Care Plan subflow. Users select Goals, then add direct Care Plan Tasks on one consolidated screen. Each distinct Action Plan Template configured on a selected Goal (via GoalDefinition.Action_Plan_Template__c) is previewed with its Tasks and generated as its own Action Plan by Salesforce.
Flow.label: Apply Care Plan Customized

fields.name: Additional_Task_Instructions_Consolidated
fields.fieldText:
Add Tasks

Optionally add extra Tasks. Choose an Action Plan to add the Task under that Action Plan, or leave Action Plan blank to add it directly to the Care Plan. Leave the row blank if you don't need an extra Task.
